profile.headline: SWE @ LMI | Data Visualization | Mission-Driven
profile.summary: Results-driven software engineer with a front-end focus and experience in back-end development and UI/UX design. Known for transforming complex problems into elegant and accessible user-friendly solutions. A lifelong learner passionate about creating user-friendly, impactful technology and dedicated to continuously expanding skills to tackle new challenges. Quick learner with exceptional communication skills, strong adaptability, and keen attention to detail.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed front end applications using Vue.js, React, and TypeScript, building reusable components and customized solutions for multiple clients.
- Served as a UX designer and prototype developer, creating accessible, user-friendly UI/UX designs for point-of-sale applications and translating customer requirements into high quality functional solutions.
positions.insights: Skills: Vue.js · React · UI/UX Design · Figma (Software) · Plugin Development · Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained cutting-edge web applications using front-end technologies such as Vue.js, React, and D3.js. Additionally, demonstrated proficiency in developing RESTful APIs using Python, SQLAlchemy, and PostgreSQL.
- Applied UI/UX design expertise to create intuitive, accessible user-friendly interfaces tailored to complex data visualization needs, adapting designs to align with shifting priorities and evolving project scopes.
positions.insights: Skills: Vue.js · React.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · FastAPI · D3.js · Data Visualization · UI/UX Design · Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) · Requirements Gathering · Technical Leadership · Leaflet · Python (Programming Language) · SQLAlchemy · Pydantic · Leaflet.js · Figma (Software) · Adobe XD

positions.title: Web Application Developer - Full Stack
positions.description:
- Developed modern web applications using Vue.js, building and integrating RESTful APIs
using Knex, Objection, and PostgreSQL.
- Applied Agile methodologies to ensure efficient project execution, collaborating with teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.
- Led the full development lifecycle of a key project in a lean startup setting, acting as the sole developer and delivering a high-impact solution within tight deadlines.
positions.insights: Skills: Gitlab · JavaScript · HTML · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Agile Methodologies · TypeScript · Vue.js · PostgreSQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Knex.js · Jira · Communication · REST APIs

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: - Conducted user-centered research contributing to the design and development of an innovative cycling communication device.
positions.insights: Skills: Autodesk Inventor · Software Development · Human-Computer Interaction · Data Visualization · Data Analysis · UX Research · Communication

volunteerExperiences.description: - Served as a teaching assistant for high school computer science, assisting with program instruction and mentoring students in debugging and problem-solving.
